column1: # How a version or model spreads. A model's weight grows linearly for ramp_days after release, then halves every half_life_days. An OS or browser version grows the same way and starts halving once the next version it could update to is out, so the last version a system can run keeps its users. Products listed in version_shares.tsv use those shares instead. Curated, checked against published version shares; see doc/data.md.
